lf: its members are the prayer names (ProtectMelee, Piety, RapidHeal, ...); compared with player.activePrayer and used as keys of prayerActivationTicks
FH: reads debuffs.boundFromTick and debuffs.boundUntilTick; true while the tick lies between them
cM: inferred: sets alive, deletes death and deathAnimationTick and raises lifeGeneration; the engine's setBossHp calls it when a dead boss is given hp again
xM: its result is handed out under the key canStep; it takes world.occupancy and asks isBlocked for the tiles a footprint's step enters
XM: its result is stored under the key impactDelayTicks and its argument is an endDelayCycles; inferred otherwise: floor(cycles / 30)
ST: handed to zebakDefinition as rollAttack: ST; its result ({ attackerId, targetId, rolledDamage, accuracySucceeded, ... }) goes into npcAttacks
RT: inferred: whether a width x height footprint may take one step from a tile to a neighbour, by arena bounds, walkable tiles and collision flags
PT: handed out under the key canOccupy; inferred otherwise: every tile of a size x size footprint is inside the arena bounds and passes isArenaTileWalkable
_T: inferred: the NPC is bound, or the player attacking it stands under it (unless movesWithAttackerUnder); the engine empties the NPC's movement path when it is true
ix: its result is passed under the key target of projectiles and graphics; the object { kind: "actor", actorId, size, position }
lx: its result is passed under the key sourcePosition of projectiles; inferred otherwise: the middle of the tile at the center of the actor's footprint
xO: inferred: a tile lies inside the size x size footprint whose south-west tile is given
GO: called as (bossSW, size, player) to gate the underFootprint option of the boss pursuit; it forwards to the footprint test
PO: calls the route search in "melee" mode; the boss pursuit handles its result kinds under the error string "Unhandled NPC route result"
EO: error string "Unhandled NPC route result: ..." for its result ({ kind: "exact" | "alternative" | "failed", steps }); inferred otherwise: a breadth-first search in "tile" or "melee" mode
jL: client/engine/playerAttack/launch.js stores its result as activeSpell, the engine as spell; null unless the selected style is Casting or Defensive Casting
OL: the engine stores the result of its wrapper (this ?? "unarmed") as weaponCategory; compared with "polearm", "bow", "crossbow"
nR: client/engine/playerAttack/launch.js stores its result as weaponFormulaStyle, the engine as formulaStyle ("melee_stab", "ranged", "magic", ...)

CC: getArenaConfig() returns bounds: { ...CC, width: 14, height: 14 }; registered with the "colosseum-sol-heredit" definition as arena: CC
xC: basePosition: [...xC] of the render config's primaryNpc; the position Sol's actor is created at (createNpcs)
BC: getDefaultPlayerStart() returns [...BC]; playerStart: [...BC] in the registry descriptor of kind "sol_heredit"
WC: mapSquare: WC in the registry descriptor of kind "sol_heredit"; terrainMapSquare: WC in the render config
RC: a uniform roll between its two values is added to the tick to arm this.nextEnrageSandTick; inferred otherwise: [min, max] in ticks
PC: its value is "sol_beam_prepared"; emitted as type: PC with fireInTicks, and the key of the audio rule that checks e.type
_C: inferred: outside the enrage phase a uniform roll between its two values is added to the fire tick to make the beams' readyTick
FC: the position of the spawned actor "sol_quartet_warbander" is picked from it at random
EC: each entry is passed as corners of an actor "sol_solarflare_<n>" and becomes its route
NC: npcTypeId: NC under the key sol (archetypeId "sol_heredit") and of the render config's primaryNpc; error string "Missing Sol Heredit monster HP" after getMonsterHitpoints(NC)
GC: added to the tick to make pendingTriple[].tick when the triple is not long (long: false, clip "tripleShort")
UC: added to the tick to make pendingTriple[].tick when the triple is long (long: true, from phase 3)
jC: stored as pendingTriple[].damage when the triple is not long; becomes baseDamage of source "SolTripleAttack"
OC: stored as pendingTriple[].damage when the triple is long; becomes baseDamage of source "SolTripleAttack"
$C: indexed by state.relentless and added to plan.maxHit, the triple's damage and the beam's maximum; the Relentless tiers read "max hit is increased by 1", "3", "6"
VC: indexed by relentless; the percentage taken off the target's stats.defence.current; the Relentless tiers read "bypass 33% of your Defence level", "66%"
KC: npcTypeId: KC under the key healing_totem (archetypeId "colosseum_healing_totem")
qC: npcTypeId: qC of the warband role archer (archetypeId `colosseum_warband_${role}`)
ZC: npcTypeId: ZC of the warband role seer (archetypeId `colosseum_warband_${role}`)
YC: npcTypeId: YC of the warband role berserker (archetypeId `colosseum_warband_${role}`)
XC: its value is "sol_heredit"; used as the boss actor's id, actorId, primaryActorId and in completionActorIds
JC: its value is "Sol Heredit"; passed as speaker of the public "game_message" and written into the message texts
QC: its entries are passed as idleSeqId, deathSeqId and spawnSeqId in the render config and stored under the key seqs of the warband roles
we: its entries are passed as spotAnimId of the graphics and projectiles of "colosseum_visual" events
ex: spread into the projectiles entry the healing totem emits; its spotAnimId is totemProjectile; the warband counterpart is stored under the key flight
ax: its archer and seer entries are stored under projectile.flight of the warband roles
ux: emits the event type "colosseum_visual" when it has animations, graphics or projectiles
Vj: its red and green are passed as color of "game_message" segments
Zj: getArenaConfig() adds the tiles it accepts to walkableTiles; inferred otherwise: inside the bounds and not one of the four corner tiles

_j: error string "No Sol phase at ${threshold}"; entries are { threshold, taunt, addsCrystal }, indexed by this.phase
Fj: one entry is said (events "overhead_text" and "game_message") at deathCleanupTick, the tick after Sol is defeated
Ej: its result is assigned to this.phase in syncBossHp() and enterBossHpPhase(); it counts the phase thresholds that hp / maxHp has reached
Nj: inferred: phase >= 5, the phase of the 10% threshold whose preset hint is "Enrage."; it gates nextEnrageSandTick and rawEnrageArmTick

Pj: handed out as debugActions: Pj; its commands have encounter "sol_heredit"
ue: its value is "solHereditAttackStyle"; the key of the mechanics toggle labelled "Attack Style" and of its default "random"
Gj: handed out as controls: Gj() in the registry entry of kind "sol_heredit"

Uj: inferred: the entries { id, name, icon, summary, tiers } that the handed-out modifiers list is picked from by id
jj: handed out as modifiers: jj in the registry descriptor of kind "sol_heredit"
Oj: the item ids the setup note "Noxious halberd in loadout, but Myopia is off." looks for in equipment and inventory
$j: handed out as setupNotes: $j in the registry descriptor of kind "sol_heredit"
z$: constructed into this.modifierState; it holds selection and doomStacks
TV: inferred: the registry factory of kind "sol_heredit" parses its argument with it and passes .modifiers to the encounter; the inferno factory's error calls that argument "constructor options"

mO: stored (cloned) under formulaStats of the beam crystal and solarflare actors and the fallback for the bees; inferred otherwise: levels 1 and bonuses 0
hO: inferred: { npcTypeId, size, archetypeId } per actor kind (sol, beam_crystal, solarflare, bees, healing_totem), spread into the actor that is built
fO: its result is passed to the definitions' createActor(); error string "Missing Colosseum monster data for ..."; it returns { id, kind: "npc", role, vitals, formulaStats, combat }

Kj: its result is stored under the key centre; inferred otherwise: the middle tile of the 5x5 footprint at a position
Yj: inferred: turns a tile's offset from Sol's south-west tile into [lane across his face, depth outward from that face] for a cardinal direction
Xj: inferred: indexed by the spear's variant (1 or 2); the lanes across Sol's face whose tiles are hit from depth 2 outward
Jj: inferred: indexed by the spear's variant (1 or 2); the sideways shifts of the three-tile diagonal lines hit from Sol's corner
Qj: the tiles returned when the style is "spear"; the result is stored under the key tiles
eO: its result is stored under the key tiles of the area built from scheduler.pendingGround (style "spear" or shield)
aO: its result is passed as delayCycles of the solMelee graphic on each tile of the ground attack
tO: spread into the key memory of a new scheduler ({ lastAction, lastVariant })
nO: its result is assigned to scheduler.memory ({ lastAction, lastVariant })
sO: inferred: "south", "north", "west", "east" or a diagonal such as "north-east", by where the target is from Sol's 5x5 footprint
rO: inferred: phase >= 2, which takes one tick off the delay to nextAttackTick; the 75% preset's hint is "Adds grapple. Faster attacks."
iO: returns { style, centre, tiles } for scheduler.pendingGround; its tiles feed dangerTiles of the snapshot and the damage of source "SolSpear" or "SolShield"
lO: its result is stored under the key scheduler of Sol's state
oO: inferred: true when scheduler.pendingGround is null, pendingTriple is empty and the tick has reached nextAttackTick
dO: returns scheduler.forcedSpecial (set by the commands "trigger-grapple" and "trigger-triple"), or null while a forced grapple is not available
gO: its result is what boss.js switches on by kind ("regular", "grapple", "triple"; error string "Unknown Sol launch"); it sets nextAttackTick and pendingGround
cO: it consumes scheduler.forcedSpecial, zeroes regularsSinceSpecial and returns { kind: "grapple" } or { kind: "triple", long, hitTicks }
$O: inferred: nulls scheduler.pendingGround and grapple.pending and empties pendingTriple; called when solHereditAttacks is switched off
VO: the "colosseum-sol-heredit" definition's onDefeated and onDespawn; inferred otherwise: clears the pending attacks and guaranteedMaxHitUntilTick

bO: a random entry becomes grapple.pending.target ({ slot, taunt, bodyPart })
yO: passed as overheadTextColor of the grapple taunt's "overhead_text" event
zO: its result is passed as overheadTextSegments
wO: its result is passed as segments of the "game_message" emitted with the grapple taunt; it starts with "Sol Heredit: "
AO: its text is "You defended the wrong body part!"; passed as segments of a "game_message"
LO: its text is "You perfectly parry Sol Heredit's grapple!"; returned for the outcome "perfect-parry"
DO: it switches on outcome ("perfect-parry", "parry", "fail"); its result is passed as segments of a "game_message"
HO: it sets pending.defendedTick when the clicked slot is pending.target.slot; inferred otherwise: true for any click inside the pending grapple's five ticks
qO: applied to the entries of inputs.equipmentSlotClicks; inferred otherwise: true when the player's slot (or ammo, quiver-ammo) holds an item
ZO: its result is pushed into the tick's damages; it returns the damage of source "SolGrapple" and emits the outcome's "game_message"

OO: emitted as segments of a "game_message"; its text is "Sol Heredit doesn't take kindly to your eager prayer."
YO: inferred: Sol and its target are alive, no grapple is pending, the scheduler is ready and the target is within melee range of the given position; it gates the launch
XO: returns { launched, taunt }; error string "Unknown Sol launch: ..."
JO: inferred: the target tile is under Sol's 5x5 footprint or cardinally next to one of its sides

dx: inferred: keyed by beam direction (south, west, north, east); charge and fire are spot anim ids from crystalCharge and crystalFire, dx and dy the step to the impact tile
gx: its result is passed under the key graphics of a "colosseum_visual"; called with "charge" and "fire"
uO: error string "Crystal ... cannot spawn at ..., off its ... edge"; entries { edge, fixed, from, to, step, direction, spawn }, indexed by a crystal's state.index
pO: inferred: the tile at a coordinate along a crystal's edge; it gives the crystal's spawn position and its path step
kO: its result is stored under the key tiles of a round's lines; inferred otherwise: the 13 tiles from a crystal along its edge's step
SO: returns the direction of a crystal's edge entry ("south", "west", "north", "east")
H$: constructed into this.beams; its hits have source "SolLightBeam"; the module's file name

T$: its result is stored under the key `key` of a pending strike and keys the pools map and the burning set; the string "x,y"
I$: constructed into this.sand; its damage has source "SolMoltenSand"; the module's file name
P$: returns a "colosseum_visual" event with spotAnimId sunfireLightning on a strike's tiles; the command "strike-sand" returns it under gameEvents

_O: inferred: source and destination are integer tiles, size is an integer of at least 1 and the destination can be occupied
FO: inferred: the route search in "tile" mode for a valid request, otherwise { kind: "failed" }
QO: inferred: an exact route to the target plus slotOffset, then to each of fallbackOffsets; unless unreachable is "hold" it falls back to a route into melee range
e$: its result is the path of the warbander's movement request; it keeps the rest in route.remainingSteps (at most maxSteps a tick)
a$: an entry is passed as role when "sol_quartet_warbander" is spawned (berserker, archer, seer)
t$: an entry is passed under the key slotOffset
s$: indexed by state.role; entries { npcTypeId, attackPhase, plan, weakness, seqs, projectile }
r$: inferred: a copy of the player with stats.defence.current lowered by the relentless tier's percentage, passed as target of the attack roll; the modifier's text is "Enemies bypass 33% of your Defence level"
l$: the attackTimer of the "colosseum-warbander" definition returns it as nextAttackTick
o$: inferred: the options ({ size, maxSteps, slotOffset, fallbackOffsets, canOccupy, unreachable }) given to the slot route
d$: inferred: cardinally next to the player and already on its slot tile (an exact route with no steps); it gates the attack
c$: a random entry becomes a swarm's position and state.spawnPosition
m$: passed under the key canOccupy of the bees' route request; an alias of the arena footprint check
f$: inferred: at state.teleportAt it puts a defeated swarm back on state.spawnPosition, at state.resumeAt it revives it with full hp

u$: error strings "Invalid corner route timing" and "Corner routes require nonempty cardinal sides on integer tiles"; stored under the key route
v$: indexed by tier and passed as the timing of a corner route ({ stepInterval, cornerPause })
k$: its result is spawned with id "sol_solarflare_N"; the method orbs() returns these actors
S$: constructed into this.solarflareDamage; its damage has source "Solarflare"

b$: the tiles that get the explosion graphics and deal the damage with source "Volatility"; called with position and size of this.explosion
y$: its result is stored under the key delayCycles of the explosion graphics; inferred otherwise: twice the Chebyshev distance from the center
w$: added to the tick to make an entry of state.arrivals; the totem projectile's endDelayCycles in ticks
L$: its result is the position of the spawned totem ("sol_totem_N"); inferred otherwise: the first accepted tile on the ring around the target's footprint, two opposite corners first
D$: inferred: applies the due entries of state.arrivals to the target (healNpc with state.healAmount) and launches the next projectile from state.nextLaunchTick
M$: constructed into this.modifierEffects; the module's file name

C$: parses { encounterSeed } (an integer from 0 to 4294967295), the shape getSeeds() returns
x$: the registry entry of kind "sol_heredit" constructs it (new x$(undefined, a.modifiers)); the module's file name
W$: its result is passed under the key stylePin; it reads mechanics.solHereditAttackStyle ("spear" or "shield")
R$: emitted as segments of a "game_message" on tick 1; its text is "Sol Heredit jumps down from his seat..."
